## Reading the audit

Each runtime is split into the three cap mechanisms, mandatory player-slot reservation hooks, and the mandatory fail-closed assignment guard. RVA, byte length, internal classification, complete stock bytes/disassembly, and replacement bytes/disassembly are recorded for every site. Explicit false-positive exclusions appear in a non-patch appendix.

A static document cannot contain launch-specific displacement bytes. Table references target a dynamically allocated 32 MiB table, while player and assignment-guard redirects target allocated relay pages. RIP-relative `disp32` fields and `rel32` redirect fields are shown as `?? ?? ?? ??`, together with the exact formula used to produce them. Every other replacement byte is exact.

## Classification legend

| Classification | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <code>index_mask</code> | Widen the table-entry/raw-handle index mask from 20 to 21 bits. |
| <code>age_mask</code> | Replace the six-bit generation field in bits 20–25 with five bits in 21–25. |
| <code>age_inc_or_count</code> | Move the generation increment or entry-count constant by one bit. |
| <code>table_bytes</code> | Increase the table byte extent from 16 MiB to 32 MiB. |
| <code>clear_age</code> | Clear the five-bit generation field while retaining the widened index. |
| <code>clear_next</code> | Clear the widened next-index field. |
| <code>table_relocation</code> | Retarget one RIP-relative table-address displacement. |
| <code>init_guard</code> | Conditionally prevent stock initialization from overwriting the raised pool. |
| <code>assignment_guard_hook</code> | Redirect every assignment CALL through the mandatory pre-publication generation guard. |
| <code>player_selector_hook</code> | Select the detached vanilla player slot through a mandatory relay. |
| <code>player_release_hook</code> | Quarantine the released player slot instead of appending it to the FIFO. |
| <code>player_constructor_hook</code> | Arm the exact PlayerCharacter object before its authenticated constructor call. |

## Regeneration

Run from the `Skyrim/` project directory after regenerating or reviewing the JSON profiles:

```powershell
python probes\gen_patch_docs.py --se artifacts\patch_SE.json --ae artifacts\patch_AE.json --gog artifacts\patch_GOG.json --vr artifacts\patch_VR.json --out-dir docs\patch-sites
python probes\verify_deliverable.py --offline
```

The verifier renders these files again in memory, requires byte-for-byte equality, and independently derives every documented mutation/evidence record ID from the exact JSON schema, requiring each one exactly once.
